_comment: Add this `hooks` block to your global ~/.claude/settings.json (alongside permissions, enabledPlugins, etc.) to make git-hud chime on agent events. Port 47600 must match config.json's agentPort.

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "try { iwr -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:47600/?type=stop&project=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString(($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR + ''))) -Method POST -TimeoutSec 2 | Out-Null } catch {}"

powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "try { iwr -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:47600/?type=permission&project=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString(($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR + ''))) -Method POST -TimeoutSec 2 | Out-Null } catch {}"

powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "try { iwr -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:47600/?type=idle&project=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString(($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR + ''))) -Method POST -TimeoutSec 2 | Out-Null } catch {}"
